correctness.rationale: Original Eq (11) yields exact iid multiplicative recursion. Direct integral and strict cumulant convexity establish a unique p root for each a>2; the strong law establishes almost-sure decay. Uniform exponential-integrability dominates log powers and justifies convergence to centered logistic variance pi^2/3, yielding the 12/pi^2 coefficient. Numerical crosschecks of critical formulas reproduced independently.

value.rationale: A natural, practical diagnostic omitted by the mean-square and almost-sure stability dichotomy is which intermediate moments remain stable. The classification yields an exact full hierarchy and the nontrivial sharp logarithmic collapse with stiffness, explaining a serious reliability limitation of a published method. It is not a mere table recomputation, p=2 restatement or arbitrary parameter slice.
